c450837652c52f4e289dfec14c05d0ce58849e79.text: 3:4 vertical ultra-realistic candid smartphone photograph of one 22-year-old adult East Asian woman walking through a leafy neighborhood park near the end of a warm summer day, carrying a small bottle of water after an evening stroll.
